journal.jaymoskingdoms.need: You need a Traveller's Journal in your inventory or bauble slots (craft a book with a map)
journal.jaymoskingdoms.no_places: No settlement knows your name yet.
journal.jaymoskingdoms.forecast.by: Foretold by the almanacs and the court wizards
journal.jaymoskingdoms.sub.map: The land about you, %s blocks across
journal.jaymoskingdoms.order.title: %s: %s
journal.jaymoskingdoms.order.text: Work for your job as %s. Each finished order pays %s emeralds at dusk.
journal.jaymoskingdoms.hearth.0: For whoever picks this up after me.
journal.jaymoskingdoms.hearth.1: A door opens for a deed, never for a wish.
journal.jaymoskingdoms.borderlands.0: One great thing falls; the ground takes note.
journal.jaymoskingdoms.borderlands.1: Someone up there wants iron shaped, not found.
journal.jaymoskingdoms.wildlands.0: Five of the great ones. Then stop counting.
journal.jaymoskingdoms.wildlands.1: Down where stone bleeds, and back, breathing.
journal.jaymoskingdoms.wildlands.2: Bring home what the cloud's guardians keep.
journal.jaymoskingdoms.wildlands.3: The standing stones hum. They wait.
journal.jaymoskingdoms.dread.0: A dozen, minus the ones who ran.
journal.jaymoskingdoms.dread.1: The three-headed one, out of sand and bone.
journal.jaymoskingdoms.dread.2: Broken, mended, struck once, flown, brought home.
journal.jaymoskingdoms.dread.3: Trust no pod that was never struck.
journal.jaymoskingdoms.legend.1: The one at the end, who does not stay slept.
journal.jaymoskingdoms.legend.2: Dust-country wreckage: take a set, leave the rest.
journal.jaymoskingdoms.legend.3: Past this the pages are blank. I looked.
journal.jaymoskingdoms.borderlands.3: Gold crown, little hands. Take it off him.
journal.jaymoskingdoms.wildlands.4: A king on a throne of stone, too big for his hall.
journal.jaymoskingdoms.dread.4: Under the purple glass, a dead man laughs.
journal.jaymoskingdoms.dread.5: The swine have a king. He's warm.
journal.jaymoskingdoms.legend.4: The four crowns first. Then the one out of sand and bone.
journal.jaymoskingdoms.captain.rank.5: The most feared of his tribe.
journal.jaymoskingdoms.captain.nothing_k: You know nothing of him yet.
journal.jaymoskingdoms.captain.sworn.obj: He killed you. He won't stop.
